slides.0.title: Yarra Valley and Mornington Peninsula
slides.0.subtitle: Level 1 · Module 4 · Lesson 1
slides.1.title: Yarra Valley: Victoria's Crown Jewel
slides.1.points.0: Location: 50 km east of Melbourne; altitude 50–400 m
slides.1.points.1: Climate: cool and damp; two sub-zones — Upper (cooler, 300–400 m) and Lower Yarra (warmer)
slides.1.points.2: Key varieties: Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, Pinot Gris, Syrah (upper zone)
slides.1.points.3: Style: elegant and restrained; red cherry, earthy complexity, high natural acidity
slides.1.points.4: Prestige producers: Yering Station, De Bortoli, Coldstream Hills, Giant Steps
slides.2.title: Mornington Peninsula: Boutique Perfection
slides.2.points.0: Location: 90-minute drive south of Melbourne; peninsula surrounded by Port Phillip Bay and Bass Strait
slides.2.points.1: Climate: cool maritime — strong sea breezes from two sides; very consistent temperatures
slides.2.points.2: Key varieties: Pinot Noir (60%), Chardonnay, Pinot Gris
slides.2.points.3: Soil: mainly red volcanic (Moorooduc) and clay loam
slides.2.points.4: Style: Pinot of great delicacy; Chardonnay with precision and mineral tension
slides.2.points.5: Top producers: Paringa Estate, Main Ridge, Ten Minutes by Tractor, Kooyong
slides.3.title: Yarra vs Mornington: Both Great Pinot Regions
slides.3.left.label: Yarra Valley
slides.3.right.label: Mornington Peninsula
slides.3.right.points.0: Peninsula; constant sea breezes from two sides
slides.4.question: What makes Mornington Peninsula's climate uniquely consistent for Pinot Noir?
slides.4.options.1: Being surrounded by Port Phillip Bay and Bass Strait, which delivers consistent cool maritime breezes from two directions
slides.4.options.2: Its location very high in the mountains
slides.4.explanation: The Mornington Peninsula is surrounded by water on three sides — Port Phillip Bay to the north and west, and Bass Strait to the south. This means cool sea breezes arrive from multiple directions, moderating temperatures and creating a remarkably consistent cool-maritime climate ideal for Pinot Noir and Chardonnay.
slides.5.title: Lesson Summary
slides.5.points.0: Yarra Valley: inland cool VIC; Upper Yarra best for Pinot; also produces great Syrah
slides.5.points.1: Mornington Peninsula: surrounded by water; consistent maritime cool; delicate boutique Pinot Noir
slides.5.points.2: Both are Victoria's finest regions for Pinot Noir and Chardonnay
